description: REPLACES one end user's whole saved `data` (what neblla.db.save() writes): no merge, no undo. Read it with neblla_get_user, change it, send all of it back with ifVersion. The user's open app gets it live; it counts against the app's storage and goes to the developer's own database if one is set. A save still waiting on the user's offline device can overwrite it later. More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_user_data

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

data.description: The whole new object: no key starting with $ or containing ".", at most 100,000 characters of JSON and 10 levels.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

ifVersion.description: `dataRev` from neblla_get_user: if the user saved since, nothing is written; you get `stale` with their current data and dataRev. Left out: overwrites.

name: neblla_update_user_data
title: Change a user's saved data
